questions.question: In ΔABC, D is a point on BC such that ∠ADB = 2∠DAC, ∠BAC = 70° and ∠B = 46°. What is the measure of ∠ADC?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

In ΔABC, D is a point on BC

∠ADB = 2∠DAC ∠BAC = 70° and ∠B = 46°

**Concept Used:**

linear pair of angles

Sum of linear pair of angles = 180°

Sum of angles of triangle = 180°

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee6044bbc66aaa19ba8b4d79d294787fd890a1b55b60cc73ee86ebaf63252b0c.png] 

Let ∠DAC be x

So, ∠ADB = 2x

Since,

∠BAC = 70°

So, ∠BAD = (70° - x)

Now,

In ΔABD

46° + 2x + 70° - x = 180°

⇒ x = 180° - 46° - 70°

⇒ x = 64°

⇒ 2x = 128°

Now, By linear pair of angles

∠ADB + ∠ADC = 180°

⇒ 2x + ∠ADC = 180°

⇒ 128° + ∠ADC = 180°

⇒ ∠ADC = 180° - 128°

⇒ ∠ADC = 52°

**∴ The measure of ∠ADC is 52°.**

questions.question: If 24 men can build a wall in 6 days, then how many days will 36 men take to build a wall of the same type and of double the length?

Profit = 30%

**Concept used:**

Selling price = Cost price - Cost price × loss%

Selling price = Cost price + Cost price × profit%

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price be Rs. A

Selling price = A – A × 30%

According to the question,

A – A × 30% = 2100

⇒ 0.7A = 2100

⇒ A = 2100/0.7

⇒ A = 3000

So, the cost price of the cycle = Rs. 3000

Now,

Selling price at 30% profit = 3000 + 3000 × 30%

⇒ Rs. 3900

**∴ He wants to sell the cycle to earn a profit of 30% at 3900 (in ₹).**

questions.question: A sum of ₹9,000 is lent partly at 7% and the remaining at 9% per annum. If the yearly interest on the average is 8.5%, then the sum (in ₹) which is lent at 9% is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of sums using Alligation = (Higher Rate − Avg Rate) : (Avg Rate − Lower Rate)

Ratio (7% : 9%) = (9 − 8.5) : (8.5 − 7) = 0.5 : 1.5 = 1 : 3

Total 4 units (1 + 3) = ₹9,000

Sum lent at 9% (3 units) = (9000 ÷ 4) × 3 = 2250 × 3 = ₹6,750

**∴ The correct answer is 6750.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total principal = ₹9,000

Rate 1 = 7% | Rate 2 = 9%

Average interest rate = 8.5%

**Formula Used:**

Alligation Method: Ratio of quantities = (Rate₂ − Rateₐvg) : (Rateₐvg − Rate₁)

 Part 1 (7%) Part 2 (9%) Avg (8.5%) 
• 
• 
• 
• (9 − 8.5) = 0.5 (8.5 − 7) = 1.5 Ratio = 1 : 3 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Ratio of sum lent at 7% to sum lent at 9% = (9 − 8.5) : (8.5 − 7)

⇒ Ratio = 0.5 : 1.5

⇒ Ratio = 1 : 3

⇒ Sum of ratio parts = 1 + 3 = 4 units

⇒ 4 units = ₹9,000

⇒ 1 unit = 9000 ÷ 4 = ₹2,250

⇒ Sum lent at 9% = 3 units = 3 × 2,250

⇒ Sum lent at 9% = ₹6,750

questions.question: In a triangle PQR, length of the side QR is less than twice the length of the side PQ by 3 cm. Length of the side PR exceeds length of the side PQ by 12 cm. If the perimeter of the triangle is 57 cm, then 50% of the length of the smallest side of ΔPQR is equal to:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

In ΔPQR,

QR = (2 × PQ - 3) And PR = PQ + 12

Perimeter of ΔPQR = 57 cm

**Concept used:**

The perimeter of a triangle is the sum of all sides of the triangle

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c152ae01323aaee700c7052522b78a724bab671d5a7ba1df859d46bfc16365ae.png] 

Let the side PQ be x cm

So,

QR = 2 × PQ - 3 

⇒ QR = (2x - 3) cm

Again 

PR = PQ + 12 

⇒ PR = (x + 12) cm

Now,

(2x - 3) + x + (x + 12) = 57

⇒ 4x + 9 = 57

⇒ 4x = 48

⇒ x = 48/4 = 12 cm

So, PQ = 12 cm

QR = 2 × 12 - 3 = 21 cm

PR = 12 + 12 = 24 cm

So, PQ is the smallest side of the trianngle PQR

So, 50% of PQ = 12 × 50%

⇒ 6 cm

**∴ 50% of the length of the smallest side of ΔPQR is equal to 6 cm.**

questions.question: A person spends 75% of his income. If his income increases by 29% and his savings also increase by 20%, then the percentage increase in his expenditure is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Initial Expenditure = 75%

Increase in income = 29%

Increase in savings = 20% 

**Calculation:**

Let the income be Rs. 100a.

Expenditure = 75% of 100a

⇒ Rs. 75a

Savings = 100a - 75a

⇒ Rs. 25a 

Increased income = 100a + 100 × 29%

⇒ Rs. 129a

Increase saving = 25a + 25a × 20%

⇒ Rs. 30a

So, new expenditure = 129a - 30a

⇒ 99a

Increase in expenditure = 99a - 75a = 24a

% of new expenditure = (24a/75a) × 100

⇒ 32

**∴ The percentage increase in his expenditure is 32%.**

questions.question: P alone can complete 50% of a piece of work in 6 days and Q can complete 50% of the same work in 9 days. With the help of R, they finish the work in 6 days. In how many days can R alone complete 25% of the work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

P alone can complete 50% of a piece of work in 6 days

Q can complete 50% of the same work in 9 days

**Concept used:**

Total work = Efficiency of the workers × time taken by them

**Calculation:**

P alone can complete 50% of a piece of work in 6 days

So, P alone can complete 100% of a piece of work in 6 × 2 = 12 days

Q can complete 50% of the same work in 9 days

So, Q can complete 100% of the same work in 9 × 2 = 18 days

Now,

LCM of 12, 18 = 36 i.e total work

So, efficiency of P = 36/12 = 3 units/day

Efficiency of Q = 36/18 = 2 units/day

Now,

With the help of R they can complete the work in 6 days

So, effective efficiency of P, Q, and R = 36/6 = 6 units/day

Efficiency of R = 6 - 5 = 1 unit/day

So, R alone complete 25% of the work = (36 × 25%)/1

⇒ 9 days

**∴ R can alone complete 25% of the work in 9 days.**

questions.question: If the 11-digit number 79x6402087y is divisible by 72, then for smallest value of x, what is the value of (x + 2y)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a number to be divisible by 72, it must be perfectly divisible by both 8 and 9.

Rule of 8: The last three digits (87y) must be divisible by 8 ⇒ 872 is divisible by 8, so y = 2.

Rule of 9: The sum of digits (45 + x) must be divisible by 9 ⇒ The smallest possible value for x is 0.

Required value = (x + 2y) = 0 + 2 × 2 = 4.

**∴ The correct answer is 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The 11-digit number 79x6402087y is divisible by 72.

**Method Used:**

If a number is divisible by 72, it must be divisible by its co-prime factors 8 and 9.

Divisibility rule of 8: The number formed by the last three digits must be divisible by 8.

Divisibility rule of 9: The sum of all the digits must be divisible by 9.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Consider the last 3 digits for divisibility by 8: 87y

⇒ 87y = 800 + 70 + y

⇒ 800 is perfectly divisible by 8, so (70 + y) must also be divisible by 8.

⇒ The closest multiple of 8 to 70 is 72, which gives y = 2.

⇒ So, y = 2. The number now becomes 79x64020872.

⇒ Now, apply the divisibility rule of 9 to the entire number.

⇒ Sum of digits = 7 + 9 + x + 6 + 4 + 0 + 2 + 0 + 8 + 7 + 2

⇒ Sum of digits = 45 + x

⇒ For (45 + x) to be divisible by 9, x can either be 0 or 9 (since 45 is a multiple of 9).

⇒ Since we need the smallest value of x, we take x = 0.

⇒ We need to find the final value of (x + 2y).

⇒ (x + 2y) = 0 + 2 × 2

⇒ (x + 2y) = 4

**∴ The correct answer is 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 8

A number is divisible by 8 if the number formed by its last three digits is perfectly divisible by 8.

Divisibility Rule of 9

A number is divisible by 9 if the sum of all its digits is a multiple of 9.

Divisibility Rule of 11

A number is divisible by 11 if the difference between the sum of digits at odd places and the sum of digits at even places is either 0 or a multiple of 11.

Co-prime Divisibility Theorem

If a number is divisible by two co-prime numbers a and b, it is always divisible by their product (a × b). For example, 72 = 8 × 9.
</p

The speed of covering two-thirds distance = 4 km/h

**Concept used:**

Time = Distance/Speed

**Calculation:**

Let the total distance be 3D km.

The two-third distance of 3D = (2/3) × 3D

According to the question,

⇒ (10D+4D)/(20) = (14)/(3)

⇒ (14D)/(20) = (14)/(3)

⇒ (D)/(20) = (1)/(3)

⇒ D = (20)/(3)

⇒ 3D = 20

So, total distance = 20 km

25% of 20 km = 20 × 25% = 5 km

**∴ ****25% of the total distance (in km) covered by P is 5.**
